title: CMD Kerala Jobs 2026 - Apply Online for 162 Green Marshal Posts
description: The Centre for Management Development (CMD Kerala) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 162 Green Marshal Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their 10th can apply for the CMD Kerala Jobs 2026 . Interested applicants can apply in online mode.
